summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of ColdWave AI Calling Platform. Login -> /dashboard redirect works reliably in a real browser (POST /api/auth/login returns 200, token stored in localStorage as coldwave_token, /auth/me succeeds). All 6 protected pages render with data: Dashboard (6 leads, 1 campaign KPIs, pipeline, recent calls), Leads (6 seeded, Add Lead modal works), Campaigns (3 tabs, demo campaign loads), Test Calls (config form + voices), Compliance (overview + DNC list), Settings (Integrations form + Save button). Logout returns to /login and protected route /dashboard redirects to /login when unauthenticated. Backend pytest: 22/23 passed. The single failure is an Emergent LLM budget cap (NOT a code bug) hitting POST /api/scripts/generate.

minor.issue: Returns 500 with 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.003777, Max budget: 0.001'. The same Claude model is reached successfully by /calls/test/turn and /calls/test/{id}/end during the same session, so integration is wired correctly - the Emergent LLM budget for this preview key is too small. Once the budget is raised, this endpoint will pass. No code fix required.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Accessibility-only, non-blocking. Add a DialogDescription to remove the warning.

action_items: (Env) Raise/refresh the Emergent LLM budget on the platform key so /api/scripts/generate stops returning 500 ('Budget has been exceeded! ... Max budget: 0.001'). The other LLM endpoints (test call turn + transcript analysis) currently still succeed but will fail next once cumulative cost grows.
(Optional UX) Add a <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to the Add Lead Radix Dialog to silence the accessibility console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx submit button uses type='button' onClick={submit} - this is intentional and works, but means the form's onSubmit handler is redundant; either keep type='submit' or remove the form-level onSubmit. Current behaviour is correct - just a minor cleanup.
routes.py: many endpoints share an identical 'org_id scoped find_one' pattern - candidate for a small helper to reduce duplication.
All endpoints correctly strip MongoDB _id via projections {'_id': 0}.
auth.py uses bcrypt.checkpw on a possibly-empty password_hash (Google users) - already guarded by 'not user.get(password_hash)' check, OK.

CORS middleware uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True - browsers will reject this combination for credentialed requests; works here because allow_origin_regex='.*' also set. Consider replacing the wildcard with explicit origins for hardening.

success_rate.backend: 22/23 = 96% (1 fail is Emergent LLM budget, not code)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical flows (login -> dashboard, nav, logout, protected redirect)

test_credentials: admin@coldwave.ai / Admin123! (seeded). /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present and correct.
seed_data_creation: Not needed - backend startup auto-seeds admin + ColdWave Demo Co + 6 contacts + 1 script + 1 campaign + 1 DNC entry. Verified intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_coldwave_api.py covers auth (login/me cookie+bearer), dashboard, contacts CRUD, scripts, campaigns, voices, full test-call LLM flow (start->turn->end+analysis), compliance overview+DNC+GDPR erasure, org settings, integrations persistence, users invite/delete. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_coldwave_api.py -v. The frontend login redirect (the only previously-flaky flow) is now confirmed working repeatedly via Playwright - the page successfully navigates to /dashboard and localStorage['coldwave_token'] is populated. Mocked services: ElevenLabs (browser SpeechSynthesis), 3CX live calls, Office 365 SSO.
rca of the issue: AI script generation 500 RCA: integrations.py -> llm_generate() -> emergentintegrations.LlmChat.send_message() raises ChatError because litellm rejects the request with 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.003777, Max budget: 0.001'. Reproduction: hit POST /api/scripts/generate after a few prior LLM calls in the same key. Mitigation: increase the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget cap (platform-side) or set a higher max_budget for the project. Code path itself is correct - LLM works (test_full_flow passed and produced sentiment + opt-out analysis), it is the spend cap that trips.
